assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production sky-only environment texture for an Unreal Engine / Unity spherical sky dome, not a poster or a scene mockup.
Projection and size: exact 2:1 image, 2048 x 1024 pixels, full 360-degree longitude by 180-degree latitude equirectangular (latitude-longitude) panorama. The equatorial horizon is a perfectly level subtle line at exactly 50% image height. Left and right edges must join seamlessly with continuous cloud forms and matching colors. The poles must be calm and low detail to avoid pinching. No fisheye, no cubemap cross, no perspective frame. The upper hemisphere is open sky; the lower hemisphere is only extremely soft distant atmospheric haze and a nearly featureless muted sea-color field, no near-ground detail. Only a very faint remote sea horizon, no visible waves or islands.
Art direction: polished high-end anime 3D game sky texture, painterly cloud detail with believable soft volumetric forms, elegant restrained color depth, readable smooth value gradients, enough sky brightness for a character presentation environment. A quiet central upper area so a 3D character and physical platform can be added in-engine.
Hard constraints: sky and distant atmospheric horizon only. No people, characters, faces, animals, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, frame, UI, platforms, floor, terrain, mountains, forest, trees, architecture, buildings, roof, columns, railing, floating island, ornamental props or nearby objects. No dramatic central focal object, no oversaturated concept-art nebula, no bloom glare, no lens flare.
Primary request: a clean bright late-morning azure sky above a remote hazy sea, for an elegant anime sky terrace. Gentle clear soft-blue sky, large delicately detailed white cumulus clouds clustered low in the sky just above the horizon, with subtle lavender-gray cloud undersides and sunlit cream edges. The central upper sky remains spacious, nearly cloudless and blue. Barely visible pale turquoise maritime haze on the horizon. Moderate contrast; calm, fresh and luminous without blown-out white.
assets.visual_review: Flat-image inspection: clean open blue upper sky, detailed low white clouds, diffuse distant sea; no characters, text or near-field geometry. Horizon is approximately V=0.63 rather than requested 0.50.
